verdict.rationale: Restate ships a single self-contained binary that runs the full engine locally with one command (restate-docs-13, restate-docs-26, restate-probe-rt-3), and docs describe a testing utility that spins up a Restate Server via Testcontainers to test handlers (restate-docs-23). However, there is no evidence of time-skipping test utilities or explicit step-mocking APIs as described in the story. Missing for 10: documented time-skipping/fast-forward test helpers, explicit mocked-step/unit-test APIs beyond Testcontainers-based integration testing.
